items.title: Trump defamation suit against Murdoch, WSJ over Epstein letter dismissed with prejudice
items.description: President Donald Trump denied writing a birthday letter to sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, which was the subject of a 2025 Wall Street Journal article.

items.title: Binance says 90% of $6.3 billion hack losses are now covered, plans to resume withdrawals Sunday
items.description: Binance says it has restored backing for 90% of assets affected by its $6.3 billion hack and is planning to resume withdrawals, subject to security checks.

items.title: SpaceX loses bid to toss NAACP lawsuit over Memphis data center air pollution
items.description: The Colossus data centers and a power plant that SpaceXAI is also building in Southaven, Mississippi, have faced community backlash for years.

items.title: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round
items.description: The funding round is still in progress and has not closed, so the figures are subject to change, a person directly familiar with the deal told CNBC.

items.title: Binance, crypto and hacks: What to know about keeping coin safe as cyber criminals advance
items.description: The Binance hack of $6.3 billion, the largest crypto theft ever, is a wake-up call for investors to understand how coin is guarded and the risk of losing it.

items.title: Stocks started the week with promise but ended in despair. Our take on the big reversal
items.description: Big Tech earnings reignited AI spending fears, sending investors into defensive stocks.

items.title: Qatari mediators held talks in Tehran aimed at restarting direct U.S.-Iran negotiations, source says
items.description: Axios reported that Qatari mediators held more than 12 hours of talks in Tehran on Friday to reach a deal to avoid a resumption of American-led attacks on Iran.

items.title: Automatic 401(k) rollovers reduce cash-outs, research finds — but few accounts reach new employer plans
items.description: Workers with small 401(k) balances are cashing out less often under an automatic portability program, but most accounts remain in temporary IRAs.

items.title: In the wake of Weil, a legal recruiter's advice for surviving a company wind-down
items.description: Legal recruiter Danielle Thompson shares her best advice for the employees of Weil, Gotshal & Manges and others who face a company wind-down or dissolution.

items.title: 35-year-old took on $20K in debt to launch a business from her dining room—now it brings in 8 figures a year
items.description: Set Active founder Lindsey Carter shares how she learned to separate her professional stress from her personal life while growing her athleisure company.

items.title: How to start an art collection on any budget
items.description: A guide to beginning an art collection, including how to research artists, what to buy, and where to connect, from galleries to fairs to auction houses.

items.title: Trump promised to slash energy costs  — but gasoline, diesel and jet fuel all soared instead
items.description: President Donald Trump promised voters who were angry about inflation that he would slash gasoline prices below $2 a gallon in his first year in office.

items.title: Berkshire ekes out some new highs, but October rally stalls
items.description: Berkshire Hathaway shares managed to set a few more all-time highs in an otherwise lackluster week of trading.

items.title: ‘Pop-up’ super PACs pour $637 million into 2026 midterm races
items.description: Twenty-two late-forming super PACs spent about $637 million in 2026 congressional races, sometimes before voters could see their donors.

items.title: Automakers like Rivian and Ford are ‘democratizing 3D printing’ to reduce costs and increase speed
items.description: Automakers including Ford, Rivian and GM are expanding 3D printing to make prototypes, factory tools and low-volume parts faster and at lower cost.

items.title: Humans are still doing the work behind some AI agents

items.title: Anthropic's path to the Nasdaq just got a lot bumpier
items.description: Concerning projections from hyperscalers this week punished tech stocks and pushed the Nasdaq to its first three-week losing streak since March.

items.title: Trump called out Big Oil profits. Here’s how much their refining earnings have surged since
items.description: Trump criticized Big Oil for making “too much money,” but oil majors have since reported surging refining earnings as fuel supplies tightened.

items.title: AI is coming to construction sites. But does it make workers safer?
items.description: AI is flagging hazards on construction sites, but researchers say evidence that the technology prevents injuries remains limited.

items.title: Alaska Senate election: DOJ wants to 'segregate' all ballots for 2nd Sullivan candidate
items.description: The winner of the Alaska election could determine whether Republicans retain their majority in the U.S. Senate or if Democrats take control of the chamber.
